items.claim: Chanel Dyier hasn't fought great opposition yet.
items.quote: She hasn't fought great opposition yet

items.claim: Elise Reed has lost to a lot of women's fighters in the strawweight division.
items.quote: Elise Reed has lost to a lot of women's fighters in the strawweight division to say the least.

items.claim: Elise Reed has okay boxing, which is the main part of her game.
items.quote: Reed has some okay boxing. That's the main part of her game.

items.claim: Wes Schultz has crafty grappling and was able to submit his last opponent with a third-round guillotine.
items.quote: Wes Schultz does have some crafty grappling. Um, and he was able to submit his last opponent using that crafty grappling over three rounds... I think he got a third round guillotine

items.claim: Jackson McVey lost to Zachary Reese.
items.quote: Jackson McVey has lost to Zachary Reee.

items.claim: Wes Schultz was put away in the first round by Damen Pinas and also lost to Manur Abdul Malik.
items.quote: he ran into Damen Pinas and Pinas put him away in the first round and he also lost to Manur Abdul Malik.

items.claim: Gage Young is durable and able to tough it out against powerful opponents.
items.quote: Gage Young was able to tough it out.

items.claim: Stan Dorsenville has knockout power and is an athletic finisher.
items.quote: Stan Dorsenville has got some knockout power. He's an athletic guy from Haiti... Stan Dorsaneville from Haiti is a finisher

items.claim: Gage Young has great cardio and is always moving to make people work in fights.
items.quote: Gage Young's tough. He's got great cardio. He doesn't like secede. He doesn't like give in to a positional dominant player. He's always moving and making people work in fights.

items.claim: Stan Dorsenville is stepping into the fight on short notice.
items.quote: Stan Dorsaneville, who's stepping in on short notice here
